node-1.label: Patient presented with perianal pain worsening over four days, accompanied by overall fatigue and diminished sense of taste

node-2.label: Patient is a 70-year-old Chinese man with no significant past medical history; he appeared fragile but alert.

node-3.label: Physical examination: temperature 36.3°C, blood pressure 93/66 mmHg, heart rate 72 beats/minute; digital anal examination revealed a 6×4 cm lump with obvious pressure pain, unclear border, and no necrotic skin fading detected.
